notes: v7_7_1 (supervised re-freeze, Stephen 2026-11-09, same day as 7_7_0). Completes the Game Board port - 7_7_0 shipped it missing the last two rounds of the standalone scoreboard's design iteration. TWO CHANGES, both presentation-layer, NO data-marker edits (still 16 markers). (1) WALL MODE restored (from sb_2_2_0): body.gb-wall compacts the hub header, nav and every Game Board element - 28px lanes, 22px horses, hidden note and blurb - so the board fits a portrait/vertical wall screen. AUTO-ON when the viewport is portrait AND >=800px wide, so a vertical TV or rotated monitor gets it and a phone does not (this differs from sb_2_2_0, which keyed on orientation alone and so caught phones too). A WALL MODE button in the pane head forces it either way, and gbApplyWall() re-runs on every render so the state survives a sub-tab or SM click. sb_2_2_0's compact-only .tradebar is deliberately NOT ported: it existed because compact mode hid the note that carried the trade toggle, and the hub's own Scope segment is always visible, wall mode included. (2) HOME CATEGORY ORDER restored to sb_2_0_1's: Maintenance, then Memberships & Reviews, then Channel & Total Sales, then Demand. 7_7_0 had reordered it to put Maintenance last - unrequested drift, reverted. The sb_2_1_0 fixed-track geometry (TRACK_MAX 1.8, goal at 1/1.8, MAX chip at the right edge, pace scaled by the same divisor) was already correct in 7_7_0 and is unchanged. All four preview revisions sb_2_0_0 -> sb_2_0_1 -> sb_2_1_0 -> sb_2_2_0 were diffed to confirm nothing else is outstanding. CARRIED FROM 7_7_0: the Game Board tab itself (horse-race SM leaderboard on the existing 16 consts, obeying the hub's Scope and Window toggles, races within trade, WGATE volume gates, dollar goals = trade monthly goal / SMs scaled by window, % Jobs Reviewed standing in for the un-portable 5-Star race); and the Technicians tab Avg Sale fix (tot/opps, not tot/sold - AVERAGE SALE IS ALWAYS SOLD DOLLARS / SALES OPPORTUNITIES, $0 calls included, hub-wide; verified vs ServiceTitan MTD Nov 2026: Kevin Urrutia $9,579, Armando Banuelos $12,924). Unchanged: 16 data markers, locked salt, engine math, GOAL.mq source, WIN ix mappings, all other tabs. Verified 2026-11-09: node --check clean, jsdom 54 window x scope x tab combos plus every sub-tab, SM button and wall toggle with zero captured errors, 288 races / 1,080 horses; Playwright 1080x1920 portrait confirms wall mode auto-engages with no horizontal overflow and 8 races above the fold; encrypt/decrypt round-trip byte-identical. Nightly MUST fetch this template + verify this manifest before splicing; NEVER rebuild from project knowledge, skill-folder copies, or memory.
